name: ExamQ-Gen
description: ExamQ-Gen is an instructor-in-the-loop benchmark for evaluating LLMs on university-style exam questions and decision-support grading aligned with instructor references. It supports exam authoring, grading recommendations, and robustness evaluation under different exam question generation workflows.
reputation: A newly proposed benchmark with limited current adoption, primarily appearing in the paper that introduced it for exam-question generation and grading workflows.
notes: Focuses on exam-style question answering and grading with instructor involvement; highlights challenges in grading stability and error asymmetry under different generation conditions.
